ambient: The queue advances by one person. You don't move.
Somewhere near the front a stamp comes down, and everyone relaxes slightly.
Someone joins the line behind you and sighs the sigh of a person settling in for years.
description: A line of people, patient and enormous, going out of the door and around a corner that the building doesn't have. Nobody is talking. Everyone has brought a form. You haven't brought a form, and you understand with total certainty that this will be dealt with when you reach the front. The front isn't visible.
name: The Queue

looks: Everyone else’s is filled in. The boxes are in a language of boxes.
You're holding one after all. It has your handwriting on it and none of your words.
It asks the same question forty times, and the fortieth time it's a different question.
objects.name: the form

looks: They have been waiting long enough to have grown into the carpet a little.
They turn to say something reassuring, and keep turning.
The back of their head is familiar the way a smell is familiar.
objects.name: the person ahead of you

weather: It's the temperature of a corridor. There's no weather here and there never was, and nobody has remarked on it.
